_: Her metal's finish by material key (outfit_materials.json kind metal; shaders/heroine_outfit_metal.gdshader's finish). Any key not here is bare: as built. blued: blued steel, deep blue-black, chipped back to bright steel at its worn edges (the look bible's armor-metal page, item 4). enamel: blue enamel chipped at its worn edges to bright steel (item 4's other finish; body 16: fully metallic blued steel read pale glassy silver edge-on to a bright sky, paint holds its navy at every angle; a dye recolours the paint).
_dye_paint: Keys bare as built when undyed; a colour dye paints them like the enamel (finish 2), a metal dye gives dyed metal (finish 3): fully metallic iron in a dye read as glassy coloured chrome edge-on.

pieces._: by key, then outfit.piece (the piece's name's first word): its own metal_rough and metal_env_graze. Metal r4: the Warden's greaves and sabatons, smoother with more edge sheen (a cylinder's highlight is a line); her pauldrons keep the key's 0.45 / 0.3. Armor 12 (c3): the cuirass's plate (piece word 'plate': only the cuirass has one; set 'plate' is every plate_* armor mesh) a step crisper at 0.38, its patina's patches halved (metal_blot, 1 the key's own). Armor 13 (c4): patches down to 0.2, fine scratches instead (metal_fine), its rolled edges glossier and brighter (metal_rim_rough, metal_rim_bright: a rolled binding's flag, COLOR.a 0). Armor 15 (b1): the cups (warden.cups, and plate.cups: every plate_* top's cups) polished at 0.22, patches at 0.2: at 0.45 the close-up's warm night key spread over each apex as a cloudy pink blot (read as a stain or a nipple, J1); now one small warm highlight. Armor 13 (c5): its rolled edges worn to bare steel (metal_rim_steel, a neutral grey F0, fading 3 mm onto the plate), its wear and grime by its shape and its oxide lifted 10% toward steel grey (metal_form).
